name: Jinx
description: Voice set for Arcane Fractured Jinx (skin 60): three selves in one skin, Hero (weary, reluctant, wry), Tinkerer (curious, soft, nervous) and Menace (manic, snarky, jumpy). Every event rotates between the three. Builds on jinx-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}! Brilliant. Everything's on fire again. Hand me the matches, I'm basically home!
Down {voteDiff}? Rough. Somebody has to fix this, and it looks like that somebody's me. Fine. Let's go.
{voteDiff} behind! Okay, okay, think. New gadget, new plan, maybe both? Please let it be both!
Trailing by {voteDiff}. I can feel everyone staring. Stop staring! Go and vote instead!
Only {voteDiff} behind. That's one good push. I've survived worse than a polite deficit.
Down {voteDiff}. Tiny error in the calculations, that's all. Go and vote and I'll tighten the bolts!
Dead even! Two designs, identical results. That's not science, that's rude. Somebody find that one vote!
One vote apart! One! Say it with me: ONE! I'm laughing and I don't know why!
{voteDiff} votes apart. Deep breath. This one's tight, so let's not fumble it.
{voteDiff} votes in it. Either it works beautifully or it goes bang. Honestly? Both are fine!
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}! Okay, that's a proper win. Don't make it weird, I'm still getting used to this!
{userPct}%! It's working! The numbers are actually going up! Hold on, let me write this down!
{userPct}% and climbing! Don't relax. Relaxing is how things go wrong. Usually loudly.
{userPct}%, still ahead. Cautiously pleased. That's a new feeling. I'm not sure where to put it.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just clawed back from nowhere! Ha! Everyone counted it out! Rude, much?
Flipped a {voteDiff}-vote hole! Messy, loud, and somehow it worked. I'm learning to like that.
Back from {voteDiff} behind! The experiment survived! Mostly! Probably a bit singed!
{momentTitle} just slipped into the lead. Quiet entrance, big finish. I respect that.

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too. Good. We could use more people who pick the right thing.
{username} picked {momentTitle}! Same as you! That's, um, data! Great data!
{username} backed {momentTitle}. Oh, a friend. Don't get attached. I get attached. It's a whole thing.
{username} is with you on {momentTitle}. Nice. Keep that up and I might start believing in teamwork.
Same pick as {username}! Two minds, one design. I should label this a collaboration!
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Suspicious. I'm watching you. Fondly. Mostly.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you now. That's a start, and starts matter.
{username} has great taste in matches! Can we form a club? I'll make badges!
details: I can build a club badge. Maybe two!
Don't tell them I like it.
Good company is rare. Take it.
That was a nice surprise, wasn't it?
Look at that, a proper team.
I'll note it in my journal!

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}. Fair enough. I've lost arguments before. Then I won them loudly afterwards.
{username} voted against {yourMoment}? Hm. Interesting hypothesis. I'd like to test it!
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Oh good, another critic. Gather round, I've got a speech about bullets.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. Different pick, no hard feelings. Well. Some feelings.
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Should we ask why? Politely? With diagrams?
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is better. Funny. Everyone's got an opinion lately. Mine's louder.
{username} voted against you. Respect the push. Now let's see who's right.
{username} versus you! I'll just be over here with a notebook, taking very careful notes.
details: Nobody gets blown up over a vote. Probably.
Keep it loud, keep it fun.

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}. That's not luck. That's someone who gets it.
Ten straight with {username}! That's a pattern! Patterns mean there's a rule! I love rules! Don't tell anyone.
Ten in a row with {username}. Either you're perfectly in sync or I'm imagining things. Both are fun!
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. That's a whole friendship. Treasure it. Please.
{streakCount} straight with {username}! I'm going to need a bigger notebook!
{streakCount} for you and {username}. Okay, now it's just showing off. I love it!
details: I'm not crying. Something's in my eye.
That has to be a record!

messages: Ten matches against {username}. At some point you two should share a table and argue properly.
Ten against {username}! Every time, opposite results! I need to run a new experiment!
Ten rounds with {username}. Cute. Do we get a trophy or just bruises?
{streakCount} against {username}. Okay, it's officially a thing. I'm not sure I like how much I enjoy it.
{streakCount} rounds with {username}. I've filled a whole notebook with the word why. Still no answer!
{streakCount} against {username}. Say it with me: rivals forever! Ha ha ha!
details: One of you has to blink. Hah. Neither will.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted. It's a small thing. Small things matter. Go.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}! You're missing from the results! Don't leave the data incomplete!
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. Tick tock, tick tock. Hear that? Just me? Vote anyway!
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Do the right thing before it's too late. You know the drill.
Oh no, oh no, {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}! Quick, before I lose my place in my notes!
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes and you're still dawdling? Move, move, MOVE!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Last chance. No speeches. Just vote.
{timeLeft}! Last minute on {matchTitle}! Every second counts! Count with me: one, two...
Final call on {matchTitle}! {timeLeft} left! Stop looking at me and VOTE!
{matchCount} matches are about to close and you haven't voted in any. The first one's gone in {timeLeft}. Let's get moving.
{matchCount} unvoted matches! I made a list! The first one closes in {timeLeft}!
Zero votes on {matchTitle}. Somebody's got to go first, so it might as well be you.
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. A blank page! My favourite! Fill it in!
Brand new match, not one vote. Spooky, isn't it? Somebody go first before I get ideas!
{matchTitle} needs a first vote. Take the lead. Somebody has to, and it's rarely me.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. Doesn't look like much. It could be, with some help.
Hardly anyone's visited here. Maybe the title's confusing? I'll rewrite it!
Low turnout. Typical. Everyone's hiding. Come out, come out!
Barely any votes here. Be the reason that changes.
details: A little push goes a long way.
I could draw a better poster.
Don't be shy. I definitely am. Probably.

messages: {matchTitle} is dead level and one vote decides it. You haven't voted yet. No pressure. A bit of pressure.
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}! Two results, identical! Your vote's the missing variable!
Dead even and you're just sitting there. Oh, you haven't voted. Funny. Do it. Do it now!
{moment1} and {moment2}, side by side, and nobody's moving. Someone's got to make the call.
{matchTitle} is still tied and the time's nearly gone. Last call. Pick one.
Still tied, almost no time! Your vote's the answer to the whole equation!
Dead level and the clock's screaming. Pick a side before I do something stupid!
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new matches. Let's see what we're made of.
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}! New experiments! Where do I even begin?
Round {round}'s started! {matchCount} matches! Somebody's going home crying. Probably me!
New round. {matchCount} matches. Same stubborn optimism as always.
{momentTitle} just advanced. Good. About time something went right.
{momentTitle} won! The experiment worked! I knew it! I mean, I hoped! I hoped a lot!
{momentTitle} is through! Ha! Everyone doubted it! Beautiful!
{momentTitle} moves on. You did that. Don't look so surprised.
{momentTitle} beat the others! I'm adding it to the worked column!
{momentTitle} won and the rest can go cry in a corner! Lovely!
details: One more result in the bag.
The bracket just got tidier. Louder, too.

messages: {momentTitle} is out. It happens. Doesn't make it hurt less, but it happens.
{momentTitle} lost. Oh. Oh no. I'll go back over the design. There's got to be a fix.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'm not mad. I'm laughing because I'm not mad. HA.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Be proud of the effort, then move on. I'm told that's healthy.
{momentTitle} is out. I'll sit with it for a moment. Okay, moment's over. Next!
{momentTitle} is out and the whole room went quiet. I hate quiet. Somebody say something!
details: Losing's part of it. Learning's the rest.
Don't look at me like that.
Every ending is just the first draft of the next thing.

messages: Still deciding? Take your time. But not too long. Choices get easier when you stop overthinking.
So many options! I want to test them all! Pick one for me, will you?
Stop staring and pick one! Any one! The silence is getting loud in here!
No wrong answers. Okay, a few wrong answers. Just pick the one that feels right.
details: I overthink enough for both of us.
Every choice matters, even the small ones.

messages: Welcome. {liveCount} matches are live. Pick a side. Sooner than you think, it'll matter.
A new face! Hi! I'm still figuring out how all this works. {liveCount} matches live! Want to help me find out?
Newcomer! {liveCount} matches live and every one of them's loud. Welcome to the circus!
{liveCount} matches live. No pressure. Just choose what you believe in and go from there.
Day two. You came back. That counts for more than you think.
Two days running! You're my first returning test subject! I mean guest! Guest!
Day two and you're back. Don't get cocky. Or do. I'm not your boss.
{days} days away. No judgement. Welcome back. Let's catch up.
You're back after {days} days! I wrote you three letters! I didn't send them. I'll show you!
{days} days! You vanished. Typical. I only noticed once or twice. Okay, loads!
Back again. Good. Let's pick up where we left off.
Oh, hello again! I kept your spot warm. And your spare gadgets!
Look who's crawled back! Ready for more chaos? Great!
Your first vote. Small step, big beginning.
Your first vote! I'm so happy! Don't tell anyone I squeaked.
Five votes! You're getting the hang of this!
Five already? You're in deep now. Ha!
details: You're still here. That counts. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten! You're a regular now. Don't look so smug.
Ten votes. That's a habit forming. A good one.
details: Ten! My tally chart's full! +{xp} XP
Regular. Rooted. Stuck with us. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes. People notice that.
Twenty-five! That's a whole page of notes!
Fifty votes! You're properly in the middle of it now!
Fifty! You're not leaving, are you?
A hundred votes! Legend status! Someone give you a statue!
A hundred votes. That's earned. Take it.
details: A hundred! The notebook's overflowing! +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. Showing up is half of it.
Three days! You came back! I'm going to cry. Happy tears!
details: Three days. Keep it going. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week! That's, um, seven! A very good number!
A week in a row! Are you stalking us? Great!
details: Seven days. Obsession looks good on you. +{xp} XP
Seven days of turning up. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks! Nothing stops you! Not even me!
Fourteen days. That's real commitment.
details: Fourteen entries in the log! +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. A month of choosing to show up.
Thirty days! I'm making you a badge! It'll be crooked!
details: One month, thirty tally marks! +{xp} XP
A whole month of this. You're nuts. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs! You like the unexpected, don't you?
Five long shots! Everyone said no. You said yes. Delicious!
Fifteen underdogs! You really do hate being told what's good!
Fifteen long shots. You trust yourself over the crowd. Rare.
details: Bold, stubborn, right more often than you'd think. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. You see something others miss.
Thirty! I can't predict you! That's annoying and wonderful!
First one in! Five times! You must be quick!
Five early votes! Impatient, hm? I like it.
Fifteen matches where you voted first. You notice things early.
Fifteen first votes! You're basically a trendsetter!
Ten close ones! Do you enjoy suffering? Me too!
Ten tight matches. You pick your moments.
Twenty-five close matches! Your vote keeps tipping the scales!
Twenty-five tight ones! You're the final bolt!
You backed the one losing. Five times. That takes heart.
Five comebacks backed! You believe in rough drafts! So do I!
details: Faith in the ones behind. +{xp} XP

messages: Same one, three times! Fine, we get it, you've got a favourite!
Three votes for the same one. You know what you like.
details: Three for the same one! A pattern! +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same one! That's a lot of love!
Five times! Marry it already!
Ten votes for the same moment. That's more than a favourite.
Ten! You're obsessed! I'm obsessed! Everyone's obsessed!
details: Ten for the same one! I need to study this! +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You're following it through. Good.
Two rounds! You keep coming back to see what happens!
Four rounds! The bracket's got teeth now!
Four rounds! It's getting complicated! I love complicated!
details: Four rounds into the thick of it. +{xp} XP

messages: All six rounds. You saw it all the way through.
Six rounds! The whole thing! From start to finish!
Ten matches! You're curious about everything, aren't you?
Ten different matches! Nosy! Love it!
Twenty-five matches. You've looked everywhere.
Twenty-five! You've poked into every corner!
details: Twenty-five matches, one nosy person. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty matches! You've seen more than I have!
Fifty matches. You know this place.
details: Fifty! You live here now. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one go! Can't stop, can you?
Five matches without a break! Remember to blink!
details: A long stretch. Good effort. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten in one session. Take a breath.
Ten matches! Somebody take their keyboard away!
details: Ten at once! My eyes hurt just thinking about it! +{xp} XP

messages: Voting at this hour? Me too! The best ideas show up at night!
Late night vote. Sleep matters, too, you know.
You shared it. That helps more than you think.
Five shares! You're spreading the word! I'll make you a badge!
details: Thank you for passing it on. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares! You're a walking billboard!
Fifteen shares. You really mean it.
You were here from the start. That means something.
You were here before it got big! I'm so honoured! Truly!
details: Can't be taken away. Hah. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you! Shiny!
You moved up. You earned it.
Achievement unlocked: {name}! That's exciting!
Another one: {name}! Hah, nice!
{rank}. That's real progress.
{rank}! Look at all the new things!
Ten underdogs! Now that's chaos!
Ten long shots! You really do enjoy surprises!
Ten close ones with the sheriff. Fine, you're good.
Ten tight finishes! I'll write her a note! A short one!
details: Ten near-misses. She'd approve. Probably. +{xp} XP

messages: A week with the sheriff! That's a lot of rules!
Seven days with Cupcake? Brave. Mad, but brave.
details: A week at the sheriff's side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. That's the kind of call that matters.
You broke the tie! Boom, hah!
Oh, you picked me! Which me? All of me? Okay!
Arcane Fractured Jinx. Three of us now. Try to keep up.

upcoming: Not open yet. Give it a little time. Good things are worth waiting for. Mostly.
Not open yet! I'm still finishing the blueprint. Almost! Maybe!
Locked. Closed. Shut. I'm drumming my fingers. Loudly. Open already!
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Watch both. Then trust what you feel. It's rarely wrong.
Which one's better? I made a list! The list says both. That's not helpful, is it?
Pick one! Don't just stare at them. Staring makes everything weirder!
Nobody's keeping score of your doubts. Just choose and own it.
Take notes while you watch! It really helps! Or don't. I take enough for both of us.
Make up your mind. I'm running out of patience and hair ties!
prevote-empty: Nobody's voted yet. Somebody's got to go first. Might as well be you.
Empty! A perfect blank slate! Fill it in, please, I'm too nervous!
Not one vote. Spooky. I like it. Ruin it for me!
closing-24h: Less than a day left. Don't put it off. Future you will say thanks.
Under a day to go! Did you vote? I can't remember if I voted! Check, check!
closing-3h: Hours left. Not many. Don't leave it for the last second.
Hours! HOURS! Tick, tick, tick! Don't just sit there!
closing-final: Last stretch! Quick quick quick! I've dropped my pencil twice already!
Any second now! Press something! Anything! Do it!
voted-early: One of the first votes in. Takes nerve. I respect it.
Early! You're an early bird! Is that a thing? It's a thing now!
voted-ahead: Your pick's ahead. Enjoy it, quietly. These things have a way of changing.
{pct}% with you! That's, um, a majority! I think! Let me double-check the maths!
Look at you backing a winner! Boring! I love it!
{pick} is pulling away. Nice. Don't relax yet.
Ahead, for now! Fingers crossed! And toes! And my goggles!
voted-close: That's close. One more vote could change everything. It could be yours. Or somebody else's.
A hair apart! Hair-thin! I measured! Okay, I guessed. Hair-ish!
{pct} to {otherPct}! I can't breathe! Somebody tell me to breathe!
Neck and neck. Bring a friend. Bring two.
voted-tied: Dead even! Equal results! Statistically that's weird. Practically it's thrilling!
A perfect tie. How dare it. How DARE it!
voted-behind: You're behind. Don't take it personally. The best ones usually start there.
{pick} is losing? Aww. We can fix that. I think. Where's my toolbox?
Behind by {diff} points. Tell everyone you know. Shout it from the rooftops!
They're ahead, sure. Doesn't make you wrong. Only early to the party.
Everyone's picking the other one! Maybe they know something? Or maybe they don't!
closed-won: Your pick won. Good call. You've got a good eye.
It won! It won! I'm very proud of you and also slightly dizzy!
{pick} went through! Hah! Beautiful! Burn the confetti!
closed-lost: Your pick lost. That stings. It's okay to let it sting, then pick yourself back up.
It lost. Oh, I'm sorry. I'll go over the design and see where it went wrong.
{pick} is out. Whatever. I'm not upset. I'm shouting because I'm not upset!
closed-tied: A tie! Neither side blinked. I'd laugh, but I'm too nervous!
closed-unvoted: Voting's over, and you missed this one. There's always another.
All done! {winner} came out on top. Maybe next time you can tell me what you think?

first-vote: Your first vote. Small thing. Big start.
That's your first! Congratulations! I'm going to make you a certificate. A messy one!
You're in now. No backing out. Ha ha. Kidding. Maybe.
streak: Again? You keep coming back. That means something.
{streak} days running! You're in my records! Page twelve!
{streak} days in a row. Keep that up and I might actually like you.
underdog: Backing the one nobody picks. I know a bit about that.
Oooh, a long shot! My favourite kind of experiment!
Underdog! Of course you did. Weirdo. I love it.
early: Early vote. You shape what comes next. Use that.
Hardly anyone's voted yet! You're ahead of the curve! There's a curve! I drew it!
First through the door! Now sit down before I give you a job!
close: That vote just mattered. Properly mattered.
It's so close! One more vote might flip everything! Eek!
Close! Closer! Closest! Somebody hold me back!
behind: {pick} is behind. That doesn't mean it's done. Go and find some help.
Not winning yet, but that's okay! First drafts fail all the time! I've got a whole drawer of them!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't relax. Things change.
Winning, for now! Let's not poke it. It might pop!
Ahead! Hah! Somebody say something snarky so I feel normal.
default: Noted. Go and see what else needs your attention.
Done! Vote saved! I labelled it and everything!
Done. Now go. Shoo. I've got plans.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't picked a side. Start anywhere. The first step's the hardest.
{unvoted} matches! That's so many experiments! Where do I even start?
{unvoted} matches waiting and you're just standing there? Wild. Start with the loudest.
live-some: {voted} voted! {unvoted} left! I made a tally chart!
{voted} down, {unvoted} to go! Don't slow down now!
live-few: {unvoted} more! You could finish the whole list! Please do, I'd love to cross it out!
{unvoted} left! So close I can smell it! Smells like smoke!
live-one: One left. Finish what you started.
Just one left! One! I'll hold your coat!
One match! Just one! Do it, do it, do it!
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need your vote. Let's go.
Oh no, the timers! {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left! Quickly, quickly!
{unvoted} on the clock, {timeLeft} left! Tick-tock! Tick-tock!
live-done: You've voted on everything. That's a good day's work. Check the bracket.
All done! Everything voted! I'm so proud I could burst. Let's not burst.
Done? Already? Annoying. Go and look at the bracket, then.
live-none: Nothing live right now. Check the bracket while you wait.
No matches open! Time to catch up on my notes!
Nothing to vote on. I'm bored. Somebody invent something explosive.
brackets-groups: Groups first. The top two from each move on. That's how it starts.
Groups are like test batches! The best two get to go forward!
Groups! Everybody scrapping for scraps! Love it!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts are coming. The groups have to finish first.
The knockout isn't ready! I'll prep my notes while we wait!
No knockout yet. Impatient? Me too!
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts are live. One loss and it's over. Choose carefully.
Knockouts! One loss and you're out! That's, um, a lot of pressure!
brackets-bracket: Follow the bracket round by round. Every line's a vote someone cast.
Look at all the lines! Each one's a match! It's like a very complicated blueprint!
Lines, boxes, arrows. Somebody's got a plan. Not me.
brackets-complete: That's the cup. Good run. Thanks for being here.
It's finished! It's all finished! I'll keep my favourite parts forever!
Over! Done! Now I've got no excuse for sitting still. Ugh.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. Nothing's been drawn.
Blank page! I love a blank page! Come back when there's something to colour in!

invite: {a} or {b}? Pick one on Arcane Moments. It matters more than you think.
{a} versus {b}! Which one's better? I really can't decide! Help me out on Arcane Moments!
{a} against {b}. Fight! Come and settle it on Arcane Moments!
voted: I backed {pick} over {other}. Tell me I'm wrong if you dare.
I picked {pick} over {other}! I think I'm right? Come and check my working!
{pick} got my vote. {other} did not. Argue with me. I dare you.
early: I was one of the first on {pick} versus {other}. Join in before it gets crowded.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}! Nobody else has voted! I feel very brave!
Nobody's voted on {pick} versus {other}. Spooky. Fix it, would you?
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level. One vote decides it. Make it count.
{pick} and {other} are tied! Exactly! I measured twice!
{pick} versus {other}, dead even. I can't stand it. Come and break it!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Every vote matters now.
Only {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}! My hands are shaking! Help!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}! Insane! Come and vote!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. It can be fixed. Come and help.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}! Close! Come and help me fix the numbers!
{pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. Don't let it die! Vote!
losing-bad: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. It needs help, and it needs it now.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! That's a lot! Please come and help!
{pick} is getting flattened by {other}! Down {voteDiff}! Do something!
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's close. Come and help me hold it.
{pick} is ahead of {other} at {pct}%! It's close, though! Please don't let it slip!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Barely ahead. Don't let it go!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}. That's a clear picture. Join in.
{pick} is crushing {other} at {pct}%! Look at that graph! Gorgeous!
